description: Codex idle with a THREAD TITLE leading its status bar ('airbyte-value-population · gpt-5.6-sol medium · …'). That first segment is the only per-window identity Codex exposes — without it every Codex pane in one repo renders under the same session name, which is what the phone's list showed. Asserts session picks up the title and NOT the model/mode/cwd/context segments beside it. Redacted from a real pane.
